items.event_time_ist: Oct 21, 2026 (Fox News analysis published 7:00 AM EDT)
items.title: ACLED: Houthi strikes and attempted strikes on Saudi Arabia more than doubled in a single week
items.summary: Fox News analysis published Oct 21 cites Armed Conflict Location & Event Data Project figures: Houthi strikes and attempted strikes on the kingdom more than doubled in a single week this month, with airports in Riyadh, Jizan, Najran, Dammam and Abha targeted since Oct 5. The piece notes Riyadh spent ~$83.2B on defense last year (SIPRI) yet is shifting air-defense batteries as the Houthis exploit the gap between its high-end defenses and the drone/missile mix being fired.

items.event_time_ist: Oct 21, 2026 (Fox News analysis published 7:00 AM EDT; Rubio remarks made Tuesday)
items.title: Israel offered to help defend Saudi Arabia; Rubio says interceptors are 'the most in-demand product' in defense
items.summary: Fox News analysis published Oct 21 reports Israel has specifically offered to help defend Saudi Arabia against Houthi attacks and Trump has publicly encouraged Riyadh to accept. Secretary of State Marco Rubio said Tuesday that Riyadh is competing with US allies and the US military itself for limited interceptor supplies, calling interceptors the most in-demand product in the defense field and noting the US has its own needs too. The piece adds Egypt is already assisting the kingdom's defense, and that the Houthis have warned they will move to shutter the Bab al-Mandeb Strait with missile-drone attacks if Gulf nations join the US-Israel war on Iran.
